nodes.description: Flat list of all theoretical nodes. Exactly one node has is_core=true.

label.description: Gerund or conceptual noun. The formal name of this theoretical node.

entity_type.description: Canonical entity type. Exactly one node must be core_category.

definition.description: Integrated formal definition at higher abstraction than the source category. Present tense, concepts as subjects.

source_category_id.description: UUID of the originating saturated category.

source_category_label.description: Original label of the source category, for traceability.

is_core.description: true ONLY for the core node. Exactly one node in the array must have this as true.

grounding_incidents.description: Representative incidents that ground this node in the data.

properties_inherited.description: All properties inherited from the source category.

dimension.description: What dimension does this property describe?

source_code_id.description: UUID of the code from which this property emerged.

needs_more_data.description: true if this node rests on thin evidence (< 3 incidents) and would benefit from more data.

needs_more_data_rationale.description: If needs_more_data: what kind of data would strengthen this node?

core_node_label.description: The label of the single node with is_core=true. Convenience field for quick reference.

narrative.description: A 3–5 sentence narrative summary of the theoretical model: what the core category processes, under what conditions, using what strategies, producing what consequences, varying along what dimensions.
